newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Macquarie Bank, AMMB in derivative venture.
newsitem.headline: Macquarie Bank, AMMB in derivative venture.

text.p: Arab-Malaysian Merchant Bank Bhd (AMMB) said on Wednesday it has signed a joint venture agreement with Macquarie Bank Ltd of Australia to undertake derivatives business in Malaysia.

The agreement would enable AMMB to tap Macquarie's derivatives trading and risk management expertise while Macquarie would gain from AMMB's established merchant banking presence in Malaysia, it said in a statement.
AMMB said that as a Tier-1 merchant bank, it was able to undertake derivatives business subject to compliance with the risk management guidelines issued by Bank Negara Malaysia.
The strategic alliance with Macquarie would enable AMMB to leverage its existing strength to take a lead in ringgit-based risk management and investment products, it said.
